excerpt: Class Zero Here’s a list of things to get ready for Jan. 8 class (Copy of canvas assignment) Dec 5, 2023 - Updates - …or the empirical spine of investigative reporting Welcome to our data reporting course for the masters’ students in the Cronkite School’s Masters program in investigative journalism. . It’s time for your journey through what I’m calling “Empirical Journalism”, or the spine of many invstigative stories. I’m looking forward to a productive and lively semester! — Sarah Cohen, Professor and Knight Chair in Journalism I’ll put updates here when needed, but all important updates will come via Slack in the #dj-announcements channel. Be sure to set it up for alerts. === README.md (md) === # maij-data Spring 2024 Data Reporting class site Published at https://cronkitedata.github.io/maij-data This is the main branch of the repo. For previous versions, look at the other branches (eg, 2023-spring).
